Name: Auto Coffee
Author: ben1830
Description:
[size=6]Auto Coffee [/size][size=3]
- Stack speed buffs
- Instantly consume coffee by pressing 'Q'
- Auto drink coffee toggled by pressing 'Space'
- Change speed buff duration and strength
- Configurable options
- Add other items 
[/size][size=3]
[b]Install[/b]
1. [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).
2. Install this mod by unzipping and dropping it into the Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

[b]How to Use
[/b][/size]Have coffee in your inventory 
[size=3][u]Manual-drink[/u]: i[/size]mmediately consume coffee by pressing `Q`[size=3]
[u]Auto-drink[/u]: always keep speed buffs active (toggle with space)
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3][b]Configuration[/b]
If you feel your coffee habits are affecting your gameplay you can tweak its settings by editing the `config.json` file. You can also add items that can be consumed for speed.
These are the available settings:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]coffeeButton: changes the key to drink coffee. Default: "Q".[/size]
[*][size=3]autoToggleButton: changes key to toggle auto drink. Default "Space"[/size]
[*][size=3]stackAmount: the amount of coffee you can drink at once.  Default: 2[/size]
[*][size=3]autoDrink: will load the game with auto drink on. Default: false[/size]
[*][size=3]buffItemIds: items to use with Auto Coffee. Default ["395", "253"][/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
Stardew Valley 1.6 
Stardew Valley 1.5 (Use old version)
Stardew Valley 1.4 (Use old version)
Stardew Valley 1.3 (Use old version)
Multiplayer: Mod will only have an effect on the player that has it installed. [/size]
